record.original_question: Does there exist a Levi-flat hypersurface in P2 that is smooth or real analytic?

evidence.quote: Problem 5.2. Does there exist a Levi flat smooth or real analytic hypersurface in P2 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{P}^2 = \mathbb{CP}^2$ denote the complex projective plane. A real hypersurface $M \subset \mathbb{P}^2$ (a real codimension-one submanifold) is called Levi-flat if it is foliated by complex hypersurfaces; equivalently, the Levi form of $M$ vanishes identically on its maximal complex tangent distribution. 

Question: Does there exist a closed Levi-flat hypersurface $M \subset \mathbb{P}^2$ that is either smooth (of class $C^\infty$) or real analytic?
artifact.category_tag: Levi-flat hypersurfaces in complex projective space
artifact.status_search_result: The real-analytic case has been resolved negatively: there is no closed real-analytic Levi-flat hypersurface in $\mathbb{P}^2$ (Cerveau, Lins Neto). For higher dimensions $\mathbb{P}^n$, $n\geq 3$, nonexistence is known also in the smooth ($C^\infty$) category (Siu and others). The smooth case in $\mathbb{P}^2$ remains a well-known open problem; recent partial results include nonexistence under additional symmetry assumptions (e.g., homogeneous Levi-flat hypersurfaces).

status_evidence.title: Nonexistence of Homogeneous Levi-Flat Hypersurfaces in CP2
status_evidence.snippet: A well-known conjecture states that there does not exist any smooth and closed Levi-flat real hypersurface in the complex projective space CP^2.
status_evidence.claim: Smooth case in CP^2 is an open conjecture; partial result for homogeneous case.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic Levi-Flat Hypervarieties in Complex Projective Space
status_evidence.snippet: Nonexistence of real-analytic Levi-flat hypersurfaces in CP^n for n>=2; smooth case in CP^2 open.
status_evidence.claim: Real-analytic case resolved; smooth case in P^2 remains open.
